name: Clear Pagefile At Shutdown
description: Enables Windows to clear the paging file during shutdown, removing sensitive memory data from storage but increasing system restart time.

description_i18n.en: Enables Windows to clear the paging file during shutdown, removing sensitive memory data from storage but increasing system restart time.
description_i18n.de: Aktiviert das Leeren der Auslagerungsdatei beim Herunterfahren, wodurch sensible Speicherdaten entfernt werden; dies verlängert jedoch den Neustart des Systems.
description_i18n.fr: Active l'effacement du fichier d'échange lors de l'arrêt pour supprimer les données sensibles en mémoire, ce qui rallonge le temps nécessaire au redémarrage.

warnings.title: Increased Shutdown Time
warnings.message: Enabling this feature can significantly increase the time required for system shutdown, particularly on systems with large pagefiles or slower storage devices. The process involves writing zeros to disk space previously used by memory

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the registry value ClearPageFileAtShutdown at HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management Setting this to 1 enables clearing of pagefile contents on shutdown; setting it to 0 restores default behavior
